text: 【康欣新材：因定期报告涉嫌信披违法违规被证监会立案】9月4日晚间，康欣新材料股份有限公司（600076.SH）发布公告称，公司于当日收到中国证券监督管理委员会出具的《立案告知书》（证监立案字0042026013号），因公司定期报告涉嫌信息披露违法违规，根据《中华人民共和国证券法》《中华人民共和国行政处罚法》等法律法规，中国证监会决定对公司立案。
text_en: Kangxin New Materials: Placed under investigation by CSRC for suspected information disclosure violations in periodic reports: On the evening of September 4, Kangxin New Materials Co., Ltd. (600076.SH) announced that it had received the 'Case Filing Notice' (CSRC Case Filing No. 0042026013) from the China Securities Regulatory Commission on the same day. Due to suspected information disclosure violations in its periodic reports, and in accordance with the Securities Law of the People's Republic of China and the Administrative Penalty Law of the People's Republic of China, the CSRC decided to file a case against the company.
